enemies.name: Supply Wagon
enemies.flavour_text: Logistics would soon realize that Engineering's latest supply wagon is a little too... eccentric to transport soda bottles. It has been repurposed to toss exploding soda bottles on the racecourse.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Throws exploding soda bottles, dealing True damage around itself (including to itself).

enemies.name: 'Soda POP!' Supply Wagon
enemies.flavour_text: Logistics has realized that Engineering's latest supply wagon is a little too... eccentric to transport soda bottles. It has been repurposed to toss exploding soda bottles on the racecourse, an explosive race the likes of which has never been seen.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.
Throws exploding soda bottles, dealing True damage around itself (including to itself).

enemies.name: Musbeast Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: The Musbeast Supplier likes to carry an oversized supply box on one paw as it scurries around the racecourse. It does so because it thinks it's super strong, and because it can do this, it believes it's super strong.

abilities.text: Chance to drop its supply box when taking damage.
HP depletes over time when it loses its supply box.

enemies.name: 'Big Brawn' Musbeast Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: The Musbeast Supplier likes to carry an oversized supply box on one paw and flex its biceps as it scurries around the racecourse. It does so because it thinks it's super strong, and because it can do this, it believes it's super strong.

abilities.text: Chance to drop its supply box when taking damage.
HP depletes over time when it loses its supply box.

enemies.name: Sandbeast Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: Logistics belatedly realized that sighting one sandbeast often means the presence of a dozen. They have been trained to serve as suppliers now, but there is always the risk of tripping over the supplies they scatter all over the place.

abilities.text: Restores a large amount of HP to all nearby enemies but itself when it takes a certain amount of damage.

enemies.name: 'Faircare' Sandbeast Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: Logistics belatedly realized that sighting one sandbeast often means the presence of a dozen. They have been trained to serve as suppliers now, but the medical room is filled with competitors who tripped over the supplies they scattered all over the place.

abilities.text: Restores a large amount of HP to all nearby enemies but itself when it takes a certain amount of damage.

enemies.name: Burdenbeast Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: No one understands the danger of the Rhodes Island arena better than a Burdenbeast Supplier. When it saw a ball hit by an Operator's claymore smash through the arena's wall, it couldn't help but cry out, 'Moo, moo!'

abilities.text: Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
Always faces the side where you have more units.

enemies.name: 'Timidthy' Burdenbeast Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: No one understands the danger of the Rhodes Island arena better than a Burdenbeast Supplier. When it saw a ball hit by an Operator's claymore smash through the arena's wall, it's urgent moos must have meant, 'Please save me, God of Burdenbeasts!'

abilities.text: Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
Always faces the side where you have more units.

enemies.name: Hammer Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: It is unusual, but not unheard of, to be injured when an arena cleaning cart runs over your toes. Things become somewhat surreal when there's an adorable beast on the cart eager to whoop you with a squeaky hammer.

abilities.text: Performs 5 heavy blows with greatly increased ATK. An attack that defeats a unit does not use up a count.
When out of attack counts, cannot attack and takes significantly more damage for some time.

enemies.name: 'Rampage' Hammer Supplier
enemies.flavour_text: It is unusual, but not unheard of, to be injured when an arena cleaning cart runs over your toes. Things become somewhat scary when there's an adorable beast on the cart trying to whoop you for no reason with a squeaky hammer.

abilities.text: Performs 5 heavy blows with greatly increased ATK. An attack that defeats a unit does not use up a count.
When out of attack counts, cannot attack and takes significantly more damage for some time.

enemies.name: Ironhead Forward
enemies.flavour_text: The Ironhead Forward is known for his headdown tackles, headlong rushes, and headstrong nature.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].

enemies.name: 'Charger' Ironhead Forward
enemies.flavour_text: The Ironhead Forward has his own motto: Find a heading, and head there headfirst.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].

enemies.name: Long-Armed Pitcher
enemies.flavour_text: A once-in-a-generation pitcher who was born to throw. Ordinary ballgames have lost their appeal; he prefers the thrill of throwing at people.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].
Prioritizes attacking units on [Foldable Bastions].
Cannot be blocked.

enemies.name: 'True Shot' Long-Armed Pitcher
enemies.flavour_text: A once-in-a-generation pitcher who was born to throw. His grandfather once served in Gaul's grenadier battalion, so it's no wonder that he enjoys throwing at people.

abilities.text: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].
Prioritizes attacking units on [Foldable Bastions].
Cannot be blocked.

enemies.name: Field Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemies.name: 'Longshot' Field Shooter
enemies.flavour_text: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away. I mean really far away.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemies.name: Field Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemies.name: 'Brain Barrier' Field Goalie
enemies.flavour_text: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there. There is even the off-chance that it catches the ball between its horns.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

enemies.name: Field Bludgeoner
enemies.flavour_text: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't do it, swing again.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

enemies.name: 'Basher' Field Bludgeoner
enemies.flavour_text: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't... Nah, one swing always does it.

abilities.text: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

enemies.name: RMA70 Spikeball
enemies.flavour_text: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.

abilities.text: A standard football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Fluffy Pink Balloon
enemies.flavour_text: A football that imitates a furry critter to enrich the match experience... Hey, where did it go? Okay, it's actually a real furry critter that's drifting through the air right now.

abilities.text: A very light football that can be easily moved.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Compressed Ball
enemies.flavour_text: A football made from compressed building materials to enrich the match experience. 'Heavy' doesn't begin to describe it. Do your foot a favor and don't bother kicking it.

abilities.text: A heavy football that is hard to move.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Infused Originium Ball
enemies.flavour_text: A football that imitates infused... Hey, why is it moving? Okay, it's actually a genuine infused Originium slug. Genuinely explosive, too!

abilities.text: Chance to explode when kicked, stunning and damaging nearby units.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Originite Prime Ball
enemies.flavour_text: A football that looks like Originite Prime to enrich the match experience. Not actual Originium, so it is perfectly safe and does not explode.

abilities.text: Gives 3x score.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

enemies.name: Perpetual Rebounder
enemies.flavour_text: A football inspired by an extremely unstable entity to enrich the match experience. It is as unpredictable as its inspiration, and has already been bouncing all over the field for half an hour... Somebody stop it, please!

abilities.text: A very bouncy football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.
